newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Intracom, Hungarian HTC sign $10mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Greek Intracom, Hungarian HTC sign $10mln contract.

text.p: Greek telecommunications equipment manufacturer Intracom signed a $10 million deal with Hungarian telecoms (HTC) on November 22 after winning an international tender to supply it with digital systems, it said in a statement.
The European Investment Bank is financing the project that will increase the capacity of HTC significantly, it said.
HTC has been privatised with Deutsche Telekom and U.S. Ameritech owning majority stakes, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
